title: Notion Legacy integration token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: the lower-case secret_ prefix capitalised (Secret_); body unchanged. Twin of "Notion Legacy integration token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of notion-token-sdk-client: the lower-case secret_ prefix capitalised (Secret_); body unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
